verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Browserbase only as a hosted platform: browsers 'running on Browserbase' and agents deployed 'on Browserbase'. Nothing documents a self-hostable or open-source edition of the product. Community discussion points to BrowserStation, a separate product, as the open-source alternative, and that does not count as Browserbase's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
